## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation / Use Case

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Phase Impact

Which phase(s) would this feature affect?

- [ ] Phase 0 — Perceive (Context Gate)
- [ ] Phase 1 — Direction
- [ ] Phase 2 — System (Tokens)
- [ ] Phase 3 — Build
- [ ] Phase 4 — Motion
- [ ] Phase 5 — Reflect & Verify
- [ ] Companion Skill Routing
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Examples

## Breaking Changes

Would this feature require breaking changes to existing behavior?

- [ ] No breaking changes
- [ ] Minor breaking changes (migration path provided)
- [ ] Major breaking changes (new major version)

## Additional Context

Any other context, mockups, or references related to this feature.
